description: TrafficLight surface hidden (someip offline / nav gate not met). diTrafficLightSurface_Show (diAEControl.cpp L164) requires sta_Navi==NAVI_ON(1), which in turn requires val_power==POWER_ON(3) AND sta_naviStatus in {NAVI_ACQUIRE(2),NAVI_GUIDED(3)}. This case supplies only raw can[] (HUD master 0x4C1 + status 0x43F) and mem[], with someip=[] empty: the navigation-online signal (sta_Navi) is not delivered because the someip channel is offline, so the nav show-gate is not met and the traffic-light surface stays hidden.
